verse.text: Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.

reflection.scripture: Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.
reflection.observation: This verse captures the beautiful paradox of faith: the very ground watered by our tears becomes the soil for future joy. The psalmist reflects on Israel's return from exile—a season of profound sorrow that God transformed into restoration. Tears aren't wasted; they're seeds. Every prayer cried in secret, every loss grieved, every hard season endured—these are acts of sowing that God promises to redeem.
reflection.application: When you're in a tearful season, remember you're not just suffering—you're sowing. Keep showing up to your faith, your relationships, and your calling even when it hurts. The joy isn't denial of the pain; it's the harvest that comes after faithful perseverance. Don't give up before the reaping season.
reflection.prayer: Lord, You see every tear I've sown in secret. When the ground feels hard and the waiting feels long, remind me that You specialize in turning sorrow into joy. Help me trust the process of planting, even when I can't yet see the sprout. In Jesus' name, amen.
